ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Response to the Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's response to the Alex Pretti shooting and examine potential wrongdoing.
questions: What was the Trump administration's initial response to the shooting?
Were there any attempts to cover up the incident?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant wrongdoing by the Trump administration and highlight the need for greater transparency and accountability.

ideas.title: Examining the Use of Force by Border Patrol Agents
ideas.description: This story would examine the use of force by Border Patrol agents and investigate potential patterns of abuse.
questions: What are the protocols for using force by Border Patrol agents?
Have there been any instances of excessive force?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant issues with the use of force by Border Patrol agents and highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability.
